name: Diff Size Limit
description: Blocks git commits with more than 500 lines changed to encourage smaller commits
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block commits with too many changed lines
CMD="$1"
MAX_LINES=${DIFF_SIZE_LIMIT:-500}
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then
  DIFF_LINES=$(git diff --cached --stat | tail -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+ insertion|[0-9]+ deletion' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | paste -sd+ - | bc 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$DIFF_LINES" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Commit has $DIFF_LINES lines changed (limit: $MAX_LINES). Break into smaller commits."
    exit 2
  fi
fi
exit 0
